versions.changelog:
Version 1.1.0

- Enhanced the Skill description and read-only promise language for additional security clarity and user guidance.
- Improved the "Read-Only Promise" section to specify that only resource signals and error logs are read, and recommended using read-only keys on public clouds.
- No new features or platform support added; all platform and connection instructions remain as before.
- Documentation update only; removed the redundant skill-card.md file for clarity.
- No impact to functionality or user workflow.

- Added a "Quick-start prompts" section to highlight high-value example questions for new users.
- Removed the "Typical Use Cases" section to streamline onboarding guidance.
- sample/skill-card.md file has been removed.
- No changes to API or connection processes; usage remains the same.

OpsBuddy 1.0.7 Changelog

- Added a "Read-Only Promise" note to clarify OpsBuddy never modifies or deletes production resources.
- Expanded connection instructions with detailed verification/diagnostic steps for troubleshooting setup issues.
- Introduced a "Typical Use Cases" table to better set user expectations.
- Removed the `skill-card.md` file.

- Major change: Sensitive credential handling was tightened; skill no longer accepts or processes API Keys or MCP config JSON from users.
- The connection procedure is now strictly manual: users are instructed to download and add the OpsBuddy MCP config themselves in OpenClaw.
- All steps and guidance related to pasting JSON/API Key into chat or file-writing by the skill have been removed.
- Documentation clarifies credential security, user-only config actions, and removes instructions on field-by-field or interactive credential entry.
- Minor updates to terminology: references are updated from "WorkBuddy" to "OpenClaw".

- Added a new "Capability Overview" section clearly listing OpsBuddy's 8 core ops features, suitable for quick reference.
- Updated portal URLs throughout from `http://119.45.243.120:45321` to `https://ywdz.lxiai.com/`.
- Added and emphasized two side-by-side connection methods: self-service (portal only) and skill-guided, instructing to always present both options.
- Improved step-by-step guidance for API Key acquisition and MCP config setup.
- Removed sample file `skill-card.md`.

- Updated the OpsBuddy portal URL in all instructions and templates from `http://127.0.0.1:8080` to `http://119.45.243.120:45321`.
- Removed the file `skill-card.md`.
- No changes to core functionality or user flow.

- Improved connection guidance with clear 2-step instructions for obtaining and configuring the required API Key (MCP token).
- Updated documentation to clarify registration, MCP config download, and the process for enabling OpsBuddy in WorkBuddy.
- Emphasized that all operations beyond API Key configuration (such as platform integration) must be completed via the OpsBuddy portal.
- Expanded FAQ and added a backup config template for user reference.
- No default API Key provided; users must self-register and supply their own token.
